n48b78a0f6c.headline: Venezuela ended 2018 with 1,698,488.2% inflation, according to the National Assembly
n48b78a0f6c.summary: Venezuela's National Assembly reported inflation of 1,698,488.2% in 2018, indicating extreme currency devaluation and economic crisis.
n48b78a0f6c.why: Hyperinflation severely erodes purchasing power, disrupts economic activity, and deters investment, highlighting Venezuela's ongoing economic instability.
n48b78a0f6c.why_moved: The extreme inflation rate reflects severe economic dysfunction, affecting currency value and investor confidence.

n9637c384b2.headline: Only the Czech National Bank is doing something for the housing market, says Rusnok. Government allegedly leads empty talk
n9637c384b2.summary: Czech National Bank Governor Jiří Rusnok stated the central bank is the only institution actively addressing the housing market, criticizing the government for inaction.
n9637c384b2.why: Central bank policies on housing markets influence mortgage rates, credit availability, and real estate prices, affecting economic stability.
